title: Preserve zero-column projection hints
description: Keep empty projection hints distinct from full-row scans so queries with no table-column dependencies can skip row decoding.
constraints: Do not treat empty projection hints as primary-key-only projections
Preserve full-row fallback when requested columns cannot be resolved
convergence_criteria: projection_indices can be Some(Vec::new()) when projection is empty
zero-column projection does not enable key_only_scan
